benchmark: GoodAI LTM Benchmark — selected update tests
source: data/tests/'Benchmark 3 - 32k'/definitions; the same tests exist at 120k/200k/500k with more filler
selection_rule_defined_before_selecting: a test is selected iff at least one of its stored instances has state_change_present == yes in goodai-ltm.json; tests are excluded with the reason recorded; instances are never excluded individually

NameList.note: gold = every value the slot has held, in order

SallyAnne.note: gold = value as of the moment the observer last saw the slot

Shopping.note: set-valued slot with add / add-another / remove; gold = folded list

Restaurant.note: order changes mid-run; script generated at run time — included only if a replay harness is built; otherwise reported as not run

excluded.Locations Directions: no_update — facts accumulate without revision; composes but never supersedes
excluded.Spy Meeting: no_update — multi-source aggregation, no revision; sources never decisive

reading.what_it_adds_over_longmemeval: three update semantics LongMemEval barely has — retain-all-history (NameList), as-of-an-observer (SallyAnne), and accumulation (Shopping) — with templated statements, so Track E-A normalisation and no extraction noise.
reading.caveat: 12 static instances are 4 structures × 3 draws. Predictions and results are reported per test structure as well as per instance.
reading.what_it_cannot_do: no provenance conflicts; no type-dependent contrast on one surface; Restaurant's two speakers are never decisive.
